01 — ABOUT

About

Who I am

Engineer first, founder second

I'm a final-year Software Engineering student at COMSATS Lahore and co-founder of SketchToStack, a software agency building custom web and mobile products for businesses in Pakistan and abroad. With a small, AI-assisted team, we ship production systems fast — point-of-sale networks, real-estate ERPs, investor portals and automation tools.

On the research side, I'm developing an AI system that detects vulnerabilities in source code by combining static analysis (Joern) with CodeBERT and large language models. I also contribute to open source — my first pull request was merged in November 2026, with more under review at projects like LangChain and Open Design.

Before SketchToStack, I completed a MERN stack internship at Torix Solutions in Lahore, working on production web applications.

Software Vulnerability Detection System

AI · Research

I developed an AI system that scans source code for security vulnerabilities by combining Joern's static code analysis with CodeBERT embeddings and large language models — I built it to flag risky patterns that rule-based scanners miss, presented through a React dashboard.

05 — OPEN SOURCE

Open Source

Contributing back

I contribute fixes to open-source projects as syed-irtaza7 on GitHub — starting with small, well-tested bug fixes.

PR #784 · MERGED

simple-invoicing — CSV import crash fix ↗

My first merged contribution: importing a CSV with extra cells crashed with a 500 error. The fix reports every offending row cleanly instead of crashing.

PR #228 · OPEN

langchain-redis — RESP3 chat history crash ↗

Fixed RedisChatMessageHistory crashing on a second instance under RESP3, where FT.INFO returns index definitions as a dict rather than a list.

PR #9372 · OPEN

open-design — UUID in insecure contexts ↗

Routed 11 unguarded browser-side crypto.randomUUID() calls through the shared safe helper. CI fully green; maintainer welcomed the fix.

PR #71 · OPEN

anonipy — dead parameter cleanup ↗

Removed an unused parameter from the entity-detection API. Behaviour unchanged — 171 tests passing, 97% coverage, lint clean.
